Fiyat Loglari (/price-changes) shows 'Dip Fiyat' + 'Yeni Fiyat' columns, no 'Alış' text. All 12 items from the review request PASS.

minor.issue: PriceSettingsRequest sets floor_price only when non-None (competitor_routes.py L382-383). There is no way to CLEAR floor_price via the API — sending null or omitting the field is a no-op. Recommend accepting an explicit clear signal (e.g., empty payload → $unset) so operators can correct mistaken floor prices.

convert_from_tl and convert_to_tl silently return the input amount when the TCMB rate is missing (tcmb_exchange.py L69-71, L85-86). This can produce misleading price recommendations for EUR/USD products if TCMB fetch fails on cold start. Consider surfacing the fallback (rates in the response include a stale-flag, or refuse conversion).

PRE-EXISTING (already reported iter-13). match_status filter is now applied at the query level (L619-622) via $in / $nin on the FULL competitor_matches distinct list. That solves the pagination issue but the returned list still runs the post-pagination filter at L670-673 which is now dead code — can be removed for clarity.

critical_code_review_comments: competitor_routes.py is 1538 lines — recurring recommendation (iter-11/12/13/14): split into competitor_products.py / competitor_matching.py / competitor_pricing_routes.py / competitor_scan.py / competitor_apply.py.

asyncio.get_event_loop() is still used inside coroutines in _run_single_product_match, _run_category_match, _run_price_check, _run_retry_prices, _run_ikas_currency_sync, _run_bulk_competitor_scan, _run_apply_all, get_ikas_price_info, apply_price_to_ikas — deprecated on Python 3.10+. Replace with asyncio.get_running_loop().

tcmb_exchange.py cache is process-local and blocking (httpx.get synchronous inside the request path). First request after a cold start will block up to 15s. Consider warming the cache on FastAPI startup or moving fetch to a background scheduler.
apply-price / apply-all-recommendations still return HTTP 200 with success:false for business errors (no floor, no ikas_id, price-list mismatch). Consider 422/409 (recurring comment).

_run_ikas_currency_sync (L474-568) queries İkas one product at a time inside an outer 'batch_size=50' loop — the batching does nothing; each product is a separate GraphQL round-trip. Either batch by ID with a single listProduct(id: {in: [...]}) query, or add real concurrency (asyncio.gather with a semaphore).

In _run_bulk_competitor_scan (L768-888) the price_changes insert uses the value of floor_price directly, but floor_price is now stored in base_currency while cheapest_price / new_price_tl are in TL — the price-changes list therefore mixes currencies in the 'floor_price' column. Consider storing floor_price_tl AND floor_price + base_currency on the price_changes doc for the UI to render consistently.
IKAS_PRICE_LISTS UUIDs are hardcoded in TWO places (competitor_routes.py L479-483 + L953-958 + L1319-1323) — extract to a module constant to prevent drift.
